scope: Read-only codebase proposal. No importer, staging, VM, or general IPA execution is claimed.

existing_path.behavior: Open-source clang targetarm64-apple-ios14 plus ld64.lld platformios14; own narrow declarations/stubs and ad-hoc fixture signing. Not a general Xcode-project compiler.
Currently exactly InfernoProbe and Info.plist; cannot import arbitraryresources/frameworks.
Existing recursive copy/readback plus sync/unmount, but source/destination hardcoded to InfernoProbe.app.

Initial main accepts path+identifier and verifies Info.plist ID; System classification only for exactownedfixture. ControlledOPEN remains fixedfixture. Registration and accepted callback are separate from visibleexecution.
Actual original launchd uses merged cached jobs; changing looseplist alone is not integrated launch configuration.
Fixture relay identity is hardcoded. GenericIPA without instrumentation cannot satisfy fixture-specific lifecycle/tap protocol; do not fabricate markers or silently call import success execution.

bounded_deliverable.name: One manifest-driven owned IPA vertical slice, tested with packaged existing fixture
bounded_deliverable.input: User-owned unencrypted deviceIPA; first validation artifact can be ZIP Payload/InfernoProbe.app from current owned build with byte-identical executable.
bounded_deliverable.host_import: New companion/app-import.py produces external exclusive staging directory and immutable manifest: inputZIPhash, canonicalbundle/executable/ID, every filehash/mode/size, parsed MachO facts and compatibility limitations. No VM writes during import.
bounded_deliverable.staging: Add opt-in validated manifest route to prepare.py and owned prepare-root helper: bounded recursive regular-file tree/resources/frameworks, manifest-fixed fresh /Applications/<validated>.app target, byte/metadata readback, normal unmount. Preserve current fixture flags/defaults. Never overwrite an unrelated existing Systemapp; reject collisions, especially Apple paths/IDs.
bounded_deliverable.launch: Use validated same manifest to generate exact owned launch job path/ID and truthful System-path classification in launcher; no fabricated signer/profile/trust fields. Controlled genericOPEN should be separately bounded to this one configured app, not arbitrary callerargv.
bounded_deliverable.actual_validation: Package ownedfixture asIPA outsideGit; verify archive import yields originalfilehashes, stage new disposable validated overlay+pairedaux using existing recovery route, verify guestreadback/cleanstop, then bootinstallediOS and originalLSlaunch. Existingfixture telemetry plus root-reviewed0→1/QMPcaptures provides actual first end-to-end IPA-input proof. Do not claim arbitraryapp compatibility from this onefixture.
bounded_deliverable.release_progress: This is broader than merely extracting IPA: same manifest drives realstaging and launch. Keep current testedfixture default intact until first actual importedfixture completes.

required_import_checks: ZIP canonical paths: exactlyone Payload/*.app; rejectabsolute/dotdot/backslash ambiguity/NUL/duplicates/casefold collisions/symlinks/hardlinks/specialfiles and extraction outside destination. Bound filecount, totalexpandedbytes and individualentrysize/compressionratio before writing; extraction outsideGit only.

Info.plist dictionary: CFBundlePackageType APPL, valid non-Apple bundleID, safe basename CFBundleExecutable, executable existsregular withinbundle, supported iPhone family; no path-derived identity substitution. Preserve plist and app bytes.

Parse thin/fat MachO bounds and loadcommands safely. Require supported ARM64 device slice; reject arm64e-only and x86/simulator-only. Preserve original fatfile rather than modifying signature-bearing contents.

Check LC_BUILD_VERSION platformiOS (notiOSSimulator/MacCatalyst) or original LC_VERSION_MIN_IPHONEOS; minimumOS<=14.0 and plistMinimumOSVersion consistent. SDKversion alone is not minimumOS. Missing/contradictory metadata rejects or explicitlyunsupported, neverassumedcompatible.

Reject nonzero cryptid in LC_ENCRYPTION_INFO/64 for every executable/dylib/framework slice that couldload. No FairPlay decryption. Record code-signature presence/entitlements but do not manufacture Appleidentity/provisioning or addgrants.

Inventory every nested MachO; framework/dylib devicearch/minOS/encryption checks, in-bundle @rpath/@loader_path resolution and dependencies against actual guestcache where supported. Missing strong imports are a clear incompatibility; dynamic lookup/Swift/Metal/runtimecapabilities remain execution-dependent.

Firstrelease subset excludes app extensions, Watch payloads, appgroups/sharedcontainer provisioning and install-time services not yet implemented; reject explicitly. Resource trees and ordinaryembeddedframeworks may be staged only after full treechecks; unsupported formats failclearly.

Do not bundle Apple SDK/runtime/implementation files intoGit or redistribute firmware with importer. Keep importedbinaries/buildproducts/extractedresources external; trackedtest fixtures are ownedsource/scripts/manifests only.

xcode_bridge.distinction: A .xcodeproj/.xcworkspace is source/build configuration, not a runtime payload. Emulator runs a compatible built device.app/IPA. Linux narrowfixture compiler does not establish LinuxXcode or simulatorbinary compatibility.
xcode_bridge.first_contract: Separate macOS/Xcode build bridge accepts explicitproject/workspace,scheme,configuration and iOSdevice destination; records toolchain/SDK/buildsettings/logs, then hands resulting app/IPA to the same importer. Existing externally builtIPA remains usable without that bridge.
xcode_bridge.not_yet_available: No general Xcode SDK/toolchain or macOS build endpoint is established in current repository. Implementing importer/ownedfixture proof can proceed now without inventing a remote builder or requiring missing credentials.

limits: Existing intermittent display freeze remains known; one importedfixture pass is not release-wide reliability.
System-path developer staging is a researchVM workflow, not normal AppStore installation/provisioning compatibility.
General app launch acceptance requires originalprocess identity and reviewedpixels; fixture-specific markers cannot be required or fabricated for uninstrumented apps.
Dependency audits are preflight compatibility evidence, not proof of behavior or full API support.
